d: Long, wavy ash-blonde hair with straight-cut bangs and a side-parted fringe frames a youthful, mature face with soft, brown, almond-shaped eyes. The build is slender with a prominent chest, wearing a white long-sleeved blouse with puffed shoulders under a black sleeveless bodice, paired with a short red pleated skirt featuring a white ruffle trim and small green bows. A red ribbon bow is tied at the collar, and a silver chain hangs from the waist. A small, grey naval ship-like headpiece sits atop the head, and large, grey metallic battleship turrets with long cannons are positioned behind the back.
